newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - September 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - September 12.

text.p: CHINA TIMES - The United States says it has no intention of intervening in the sovereignty dispute over the chain of East China Sea islands known as the Diaoyus in Chinese and Senkakus in Japanese.
Finance Ministry decides to completely take over Hsinchu Second Credit Union.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Taiwan is expected to join the World Trade Organisation before July 1, 1997.
The United States ends trade sanctions against Taiwan and praises Taiwan for clamping down on illegal wildlife trade.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - President Enterprises abandons a planned power plant project in China.
Foreign equity funds show net inflows of US$135 million into Taiwan between September 1 and September 9.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Foreign funds are bullish about Taiwan's stock market, remitting into Taiwan a net total of US$382 million between August and early September.
